description: Prefer `final` over `var` for immutable variables
Avoid `late` keyword except for justified DI cases
Discourage null assertion operator (`!`) usage
Enforce method order: getters/setters → @override → public → private
Prevent generic variable names for complex types
Promote one public class per file
Detect hardcoded UI strings, suggest i18n
Prevent BuildContext usage in ViewModels
Enforce UseCase pattern with execute() → Result<T>
Ensure ViewModels call super.dispose()
Keep domain layer dependency-free
Prevent throw in UseCases/Repositories, enforce Result<T>
Prevent Flutter types in ViewModels (use UiState)
Enforce @freezed on domain entities for immutability
Prevent fromJson/toJson in domain entities
Ensure data models have JSON serialization
Enforce UseCases extend BaseUseCase<T, P> for consistent error handling
Enforce ViewModels extend BaseViewModel<T> or BaseViewModelWithEffects<T>
Enforce Repository methods return Future<Result<T>> or Result<T>
Ensure StreamController fields are closed in dispose() to prevent memory leaks
Require explicit types using strict (legacy) or selective boundary policy
Enforce DataSource methods return Future<Result<T>>, Result<T>, or Stream<Result<T>>
Prevent business logic in Widgets (enforce MVVM separation)
Prevent static Maps with Controllers/Timers (memory leaks)
Prevent mixins from owning lifecycle resources
Ensure UiState (ChangeNotifier) calls super.dispose()
Enforce UiState before ViewModel in MultiProvider
Discourage local DateTime constructors, suggest Clock injection
Prevent direct HTTP calls outside infrastructure layer
Ensure DateTime operations use UTC
Require keys in ListView and similar widgets
Match configured logger context to its enclosing scope
Avoid device-local time (`toLocal()`) in the presentation layer; use an approved company-time helper
Detect civil-date and UTC-instant values mixed in one expression without an approved helper
Detect time formatting on a value not wrapped by an approved company-time helper, which renders UTC instead of company-local time
Require a categorised justification comment on every `unawaited(...)` call
Require a stated reason when an unawaited-governance rule is suppressed
Forbid fire-and-forget async work inside `Provider.create`, which can mutate state before the widget tree is ready
Detect single-await async wrappers used to hide an unawaited future from the governance rule
Forbid direct error/warning logging in the data and domain layers, where reporting is already centralised
Require a structured context on logger calls so log entries stay traceable and groupable
Forbid tokens, passwords, credentials and API keys in log metadata or log messages
Forbid raw exception messages in UI components; user-facing text must come from stable i18n codes
Detect raw exception strings being forwarded towards the UI instead of a stable error code
Require every `AppException` subtype to define a stable code so the presentation layer can localise it
Keep 401 handling centralised in the auth interceptor instead of scattered across call sites
Require top-level routed screens to extend a base screen contract for consistent behaviour
Forbid presentation UI from depending on domain entities directly; use presentation models
Forbid raw `Color(0x...)` literals in presentation; use a design token or the theme colour scheme
Forbid raw border-radius literals in presentation; use a spacing token
Forbid dialog and sheet builders from capturing a caller-owned controller or using the caller's BuildContext for inherited lookups
